_about: US economic calendar for /market-pulse/ and /economic-calendar/. Dates from the official calendars only: Federal Reserve FOMC calendar (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, 2027 schedule announced 12 Nov 2026) and the BLS release schedule (bls.gov/schedule). Times are US Eastern. Add 'result' after a release (one plain sentence, official numbers only).

events.extra: Statement and new economic projections at 2:00 p.m.; press conference at 2:30 p.m.
With new economic projections and a press conference.

fomc.name: Fed interest rate decision (FOMC)
fomc.what: The Federal Open Market Committee sets the federal funds rate, the base for borrowing costs across the economy. A cut usually helps stocks and bonds; a surprise hike, or a hint of fewer cuts, tends to hit growth stocks hardest.

cpi.name: Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation report
cpi.what: Measures how fast consumer prices rise. Hotter-than-expected inflation makes rate cuts less likely and often pushes stocks down; cooler inflation does the opposite.

jobs.name: Jobs report (Employment Situation)
jobs.what: Non-farm payrolls, the unemployment rate and wage growth for the previous month. A very strong report can lift rate expectations; a weak one raises recession worries.

ppi.name: Producer Price Index (PPI)
ppi.what: Prices businesses receive for their goods and services, an early signal for consumer inflation and company margins.

minutes.name: Fed meeting minutes
minutes.what: The detailed record of the last Fed meeting, released three weeks later. Markets read it for how many officials favour further cuts or hikes.
